# JUSTFAN

> JUSTFAN is a content gallery showcasing trending creator content, image collections, and creative showcases. Visitors can browse, favorite, request, and download content across multiple categories.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Latest and trending content feed.
- [Categories](/categories): Browse content grouped by category and tag.
- [Trending](/trending): Most-downloaded and most-viewed posts.
- [Gallery](/gallery): Public archive of completed content requests.
- [Request Content](/request): Submit a request for new content.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free, Pro, and Legendary subscription plans.
- [Install App](/install): Install JUSTFAN as a Progressive Web App.

## Optional

- [Sign In](/auth): Account access for members.
